headline: Palo Alto Networks to buy AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion
body: Palo Alto Networks is buying AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion in an all-stock deal. Arora said the deal will help businesses secure open-weight models as adoption grows. CNBC says it marks a major investment for Palo Alto beyond cybersecurity.
note: The startup helps businesses run and customize their own AI models, which takes Palo Alto beyond cybersecurity.

evidence.text: The company is buying AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion.
Arora said the company's $4.5 billion all-stock deal for Applied Compute will help businesses secure open-weight models as adoption grows.
The startup helps businesses run and customize their own AI models and marks a major investment for Palo Alto beyond cybersecurity.
